record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> my strength<WH06697>, which teacheth<WH03925><WTH8764> my hands<WH03027> to war<WH07128>, <FI>and<Fi> my fingers<WH0676> to fight<WH04421>: <RF>strength: Heb. rock<Rf> <RF>to war...: Heb. to the war, etc<Rf>

My goodness<WH02617>, and my fortress<WH04686>; my high tower<WH04869>, and my deliverer<WH06403><WTH8764>; my shield<WH04043>, and <FI>he<Fi> in whom I trust<WH02620><WTH8804>; who subdueth<WH07286><WTH8802> my people<WH05971> under me. <RF>My goodness: or, My mercy<Rf>
LORD<WH03068>, what <FI>is<Fi> man<WH0120>, that thou takest knowledge<WH03045><WTH8799> of him! <FI>or<Fi> the son<WH01121> of man<WH0582>, that thou makest account<WH02803><WTH8762> of him!
Man<WH0120> is like<WH01819><WTH8804> to vanity<WH01892>: his days<WH03117> <FI>are<Fi> as a shadow<WH06738> that passeth away<WH05674><WTH8802>.
Bow<WH05186><WTH8685> thy heavens<WH08064>, O LORD<WH03068>, and come down<WH03381><WTH8799>: touch<WH05060><WTH8798> the mountains<WH02022>, and they shall smoke<WH06225><WTH8799>.
Cast forth<WH01299><WTH8798> lightning<WH01300>, and scatter<WH06327><WTH8686> them: shoot out<WH07971><WTH8798> thine arrows<WH02671>, and destroy<WH02000><WTH8799> them.

Send<WH07971><WTH8798> thine hand<WH03027> from above<WH04791>; rid<WH06475><WTH8798> me, and deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me out of great<WH07227> waters<WH04325>, from the hand<WH03027> of strange<WH05236> children<WH01121>; <RF>hand from: Heb. hands from<Rf>
Whose mouth<WH06310> speaketh<WH01696><WTH8765> vanity<WH07723>, and their right hand<WH03225> <FI>is<Fi> a right hand<WH03225> of falsehood<WH08267>.<CM>

I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799> a new<WH02319> song<WH07892> unto thee, O God<WH0430>: upon a psaltery<WH05035> <FI>and<Fi> an instrument of ten strings<WH06218> will I sing praises<WH02167><WTH8762> unto thee.

<FI> It is he<Fi> that giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> salvation<WH08668> unto kings<WH04428>: who delivereth<WH06475><WTH8802> David<WH01732> his servant<WH05650> from the hurtful<WH07451> sword<WH02719>. <RF>salvation: or, victory<Rf>

Rid<WH06475><WTH8798> me, and deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me from the hand<WH03027> of strange<WH05236> children<WH01121>, whose mouth<WH06310> speaketh<WH01696><WTH8765> vanity<WH07723>, and their right hand<WH03225> <FI>is<Fi> a right hand<WH03225> of falsehood<WH08267>:

That our sons<WH01121> <FI>may be<Fi> as plants<WH05195> grown up<WH01431><WTH8794> in their youth<WH05271>; <FI>that<Fi> our daughters<WH01323> <FI>may be<Fi> as corner stones<WH02106>, polished<WH02404><WTH8794> <FI>after<Fi> the similitude<WH08403> of a palace<WH01964>: <RF>polished: Heb. cut<Rf>

<FI> That<Fi> our garners<WH04200> <FI>may be<Fi> full<WH04392>, affording<WH06329><WTH8688> all manner of store<WH02177><WH02177>: <FI>that<Fi> our sheep<WH06629> may bring forth thousands<WH0503><WTH8688> and ten thousands<WH07231><WTH8794> in our streets<WH02351>: <RF>all...: Heb. from kind to kind<Rf>

<FI> That<Fi> our oxen<WH0441> <FI>may be<Fi> strong to labour<WH05445><WTH8794>; <FI>that there be<Fi> no breaking in<WH06556>, nor going out<WH03318><WTH8802>; that <FI>there be<Fi> no complaining<WH06682> in our streets<WH07339>. <RF>strong...: Heb. able to bear burdens, or, loaden with flesh<Rf>
Happy<WH0835> <FI>is that<Fi> people<WH05971>, that is in such a case<WH03602>: <FI>yea<Fi> , happy<WH0835> <FI>is that<Fi> people<WH05971>, whose God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
